avis.titre: Burns my skin. Leaves awful red blotch
avis.texte: I tried using this a twice now and both time it chemically burned my skin. Once I thought maybe I made a mistake and mixed it with other product (retinol, etc) even though I was sure I didn't. I've taken a break for days from all harsher products and I still woke up with a red blotch and the exact shape of patch. It looks like a chemical burn and unfortunately will be on my face all day and even tomorrow. If you use any other acids or retinols do not use this product. Even if you're not currently on them, your skin could still have a bad reaction.

I have severe hormonal acne and I break out at the same time every month; it's really hard for me to have clear skin with that rigorous schedule, it feels like I constantly have dark spots on my face where the spots were. Combining these patches with a vitamin c serum in the morning has worked miracles for my skin this month. The patches are VERY sticky, and even if you move around a lot at night, they will not budge. They also don't hurt when being removed, and didn't tug my peach fuzz, which was a nice surprise! They peel off effortlessly, and my skin underneath is bouncy and refreshed, and significantly lighter than the night before. I'm really happy to have found something that actually works, and I'm really loving how clear my skin looks now, and rocking no makeup in public!

avis.texte: Ok first and foremost THESE WORK. I had a pimple on my chest that left a mark. It was there for over 2 months. I tried every cream imaginable. Face mask. Retinol. You name it, I tired it. This and scar cream was the only combo to work. It's hardly visible now and I couldn't be any happier! The only reason I didn't give this 5 stars was the packaging.
